cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import cli, pyref
from test_mutate import load_verdict, py_verdict
binary=cli.build()
rng=random.Random(999)
d={}
keys=[rng.getrandbits(64) for _ in range(3000)]
while len(d)<8193:
    hi=rng.choice(keys); lo=rng.getrandbits(64); l=rng.choice([128,127,120,100])
    hi,lo=pyref.norm(hi,lo,l); d[(hi,lo,l)]=rng.randint(0,4194302)
print('keys', len(set(k[0] for k in d)))
img=pyref.build_image(sorted([(k[0],k[1],k[2],v) for k,v in d.items()]), rng)
print('8193 prefixes: front64 entries', len(img['front64']), 'cpp', load_verdict(binary,img), 'py', py_verdict(img))
d2=dict(list(d.items())[:8192])
img2=pyref.build_image(sorted([(k[0],k[1],k[2],v) for k,v in d2.items()]), rng)
print('8192 prefixes: cpp', load_verdict(binary,img2), 'py', py_verdict(img2))
